action_items: Heads up: I had to apply a one-line syntax fix to /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminModeration.js — the `Field` helper component had lost its `const Field = ({ label, value, onChange, testId, step }) => (` header during the iter203 patch, leaving only its JSX body at lines 279-283. Webpack was failing with 'Unexpected token (283:0)' and the entire /admin/moderation + /admin/dispatch pages were 500-rendering a compile-error overlay. Re-applied the function header so the page compiles. Main agent: please re-validate that this matches your intended Field signature and that no other admin pages were touched by the same regression.
critical_code_review_comments: moderation.py admin_ride_conversations correctly excludes _id, uses db.ride_messages (not chat_messages) — distinct from parcel/transport chat — and the payment filter normalization (CARD ∪ WALLET = NONCASH) matches dispatch_admin.NONCASH_METHODS. Single source of truth would be nicer (both files duplicate the {'card','cb','credit_card','creditcard','stripe','carte'} set + {'wallet','paygo'}). Suggest exporting them from one helper module to avoid drift if a new payment kind is added.

dispatch_admin.NONCASH_METHODS = CARD_METHODS | WALLET_METHODS — clean. record_driver_cancellation correctly increments accept_release_cb_count only when pm is in NONCASH_METHODS. The cancel_log preserves payment_method for audit which is good (admin can see WHICH wallet/CB ride was dumped).

MINOR: admin_ride_conversation_thread does not enforce that the ride exists (returns empty messages + empty ride object for a bogus id). Consider returning 404 when the ride is unknown — currently the UI shows an empty modal.

MINOR: ride-conversations payment query supports {noncash,card,wallet,cash} but silently ignores any other value (e.g. 'all' -> no filter). It's fine but documenting it in the endpoint docstring would prevent confusion.

MINOR: admin/dispatch/overview Web Audio bell is fired client-side from totals.no_driver_alerts deltas — backend has no rate-limit on the overview poll, and if many dispatchers/admins watch simultaneously this is cheap (one Mongo aggregate). No issue, just noting.

BLOCKER (already fixed by me): AdminModeration.js had a JSX-without-function-header syntax error on the Field component (lines 279-283). Without the fix /admin/moderation and /admin/dispatch both showed a CRA compile overlay. Please verify the fix matches your intent — see action_items.

rca of the issue:
